issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 02 returns an extra column (Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel) that is not requested by the problem statement. The task asks for the names and streets of all Freizeitparks and the names of the respective Gemeinden — returning the foreign-key column (gemeindeschluessel) provides more data than requested and contradicts the instruction "Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr." This may confuse students about the exact expected output and would cause automatic graders that check for exact column sets to fail.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the unnecessary column from the solution's SELECT list so the output matches the problem statement exactly. For example, change solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql line 1 to: SELECT Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, Gemeinde.name FROM ...; Alternatively, if returning the foreign key was intentional, update the problem statement to explicitly permit that extra column.
